briefdescription.para: Phase 4 — Failover contract hardening focused tests (FCH-01..FCH-16).

detaileddescription.para: Tests are fully self-contained: no network I/O, no filesystem I/O. All external interactions are mocked inline. The canonical PRNG seed is kFailoverContractSeed = 42 for deterministic test data generation.

sect2.title: Test families
sect2.para: FCH-01 Single leader elected per epoch FCH-02 Epoch is strictly monotonically increasing after each election FCH-03 Old leader is deposed when a higher epoch is observed FCH-04 Two nodes cannot both hold Leader role in the same epoch

FCH-05 In-flight requests completed before leader yields FCH-06 In-flight requests retried by new leader when not completed FCH-07 No silent drop: every request is either completed or retried FCH-08 Handover drain budget is respected

FCH-09 Failed node rejoins as Follower only FCH-10 Rejoining node must not claim Leader role directly FCH-11 State sync completes before node transitions to active Follower FCH-12 State sync timeout surfaces STATE_SYNC_TIMEOUT error

FCH-13 ELECTION_TIMEOUT surfaced after missed heartbeats exhaust budget FCH-14 SPLIT_BRAIN_DETECTED surfaced when two leaders share same epoch FCH-15 HANDOVER_INCOMPLETE surfaced when drain deadline exceeded FCH-16 HEARTBEAT_MISSED increments counter toward leader-loss threshold
